title: OWHS ReturnToWorkOutcome v0.1
description: What happened after an absence, including did-not-return and ill-health-exit. No direct identifiers.

checkpointWeeks.$comment: Founder decision 7 Jul 2026: open integer, not enum. Recommended set {4,13,26} (codelist:rtw-checkpoint@0.1.0); producers SHOULD use the recommended set for comparability. whiu: definitions expected to supersede.

status.$comment: codelist:rtw-sustained-status@0.1.0 — closed vocabulary; `unknown` means the checkpoint was not followed up, which is not a relapse

allOf.$comment: adjustmentTypes only meaningful for adjusted/phased outcomes

then.$comment: a did-not-return outcome cannot carry return adjustments

allOf.$comment: P1 (no direct identifiers) is enforced structurally by "additionalProperties": false on this object and on every nested object, which rejects any property not declared here, including name, nino, email, dateOfBirth and address. A key-based rule cannot reach an identifier written into the value of a permitted string field; that part of P1 is a producer obligation, stated in the privacy profile. The previous allOf member duplicated additionalProperties and claimed to forbid identifiers "anywhere", which was not true of values.
